item.title: Bangsamoro districting law passed: 48 yes, 19 no, 4 abstentions
item.description: COTABATO CITY (MindaNews / 13 January) — The Bangsamoro Transition Authority (BTA) finally passed a new districting law for the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) at 12:33 a.m. on Tuesday, after a 10-hour deliberation, paving the way for Congress to set a date for the twice-postponed 1st Bangsamoro Parliamentary Elections. “The ayes have it,” […]

item.title: Bus Transfer
item.description: Although Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon already announced the opening of the gravel detour road in the landslide area in Barangay Palacapao, Quezon in Bukidnon during his visit in the area Wednesday morning (14 January 2026), buses of Rural Transit are still advising passengers to disembark and transfer to the bus waiting at the other side.
